post.description: Start a flight booking for real travellers. Requires payment_collection "link", an Idempotency-Key, one complete traveller per seat, and metadata with itinerary_key, insurance ("accept" or "decline") and max_total (the most the whole trip may cost). The answer carries a payment page (next_action.url) for the traveller. Nothing is bought until Confirm Flight Booking is called. A ticket cannot be cancelled or changed here. Charged once, when the booking is first seen confirmed.

200.description: Successful response. The payload schema has not been reviewed yet.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

get.description: Read a flight booking: poll it after the traveller pays, and before confirming. Read it after any uncertain confirm instead of confirming again. Charged once, when the booking is first seen confirmed.

200.description: Successful response. The payload schema has not been reviewed yet.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

post.description: Buy the ticket: send {"confirm": true} once the booking asks for confirmation (next_action confirm), after showing the traveller the checkout total. max_total raises the price ceiling for this answer. The purchase is final. It usually takes under a minute. If it is still running after 100 seconds, the answer is 202, with the booking as it stands (status processing) or, when it could not be read, error status_unknown: read it with Get Flight Booking until the status changes, and do not confirm again. After any other uncertain answer (an error, or an outcome not known), read the booking before anything else. Charged once, when the booking is first seen confirmed.

200.description: Successful response. The payload schema has not been reviewed yet.
